payload.content: A weighted solid brass base keeps this freestanding paper towel holder stable for one-handed tearing, while the upright countertop stand saves space on your kitchen counter. {FINISH_SENTENCE} Part of the Carolina Collection, it brings a traditional look with subtle contemporary design elements for a clean, classic accessory that doesn’t need wall mounting. The 6.5-inch length makes it an easy fit where you want a dedicated spot for a roll, and the felt pad under the base helps prevent scratches on your countertop or shelf. This brass paper towel holder is finished for corrosion-free, rust-free performance, arrives fully assembled, and includes the paper towel holder. Backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty. Prefer the convenience of an under cabinet paper towel holder? This standalone design delivers the same grab-and-tear accessibility with simple placement wherever you need it.
